svg.title: Highlights
svg.desc: Devops At Hp Inc: 3.5 yrs, AWS, Terraform and on-call for device telemetry; Data Platform: PB-scale, Telemetry from millions of devices on S3 and Redshift; Gdpr Erasure: 1 mo → 48 h, Airflow automation replaced a manual process; Available: Jan–Aug 2027, Co-op in DevOps, cloud, SRE or AI/ML
